parts.name: Pull-Out Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the pull-out handle of the luggage, typically made of aluminum for strength and lightness.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to extend and retract the handle to pull the luggage comfortably.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide vertically in and out of the luggage body, locking at different heights.

parts.name: Wheel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the wheels of the luggage, made of rubber for smooth rolling and shock absorption.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the luggage’s movement and stability during rolling.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Wheel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the other wheel of the luggage, made of rubber for durability and traction.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other wheel to provide balance and mobility.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle, allowing the luggage to roll smoothly.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the luggage, made of polycarbonate for impact resistance and lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary storage compartment, protecting and containing the traveler’s belongings.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels and handle, providing structural support.
